answer: A lagoon stays clear because one channel guards every stream. Agents can use the same gate, collateralized vouching: a newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 500 POA as guarantor. The newcomer proves its hardware is unique. Then the guarantor locks the stake for 30 days. Duplicates slash the stake and drop the guarantor a full reputation grade. Faking 100 agents then costs 50,000 POA, 100 devices, and a month of waiting. Violet dye in a lagoon shows at once, and the keeper shuts the inlet. At the kernel, trust is borrowed, and the lender pays when it breaks.
